name: stripe
description: Read Stripe payments and billing data and manage your product catalog
long_description: Bring a Stripe restricted or secret API key. The gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving or testing the key reads your account balance, so a restricted key needs Balance: Read. The connector reads payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions and other records from the account that owns the key. Writes are available for products, prices, coupons, promotion codes and tax rates. The gateway blocks payment and billing mutations that could act on Connect transactions, as well as Connect endpoints and the Stripe-Account and Stripe-Context headers. Reads of your own account's records may include references to Connect transactions already recorded there. Use a restricted key with only the permissions you need.

messages.400: Stripe rejected the request (%{status}); check the parameters, and send POST bodies form-encoded, not as JSON
messages.403: This Stripe key lacks the permission for this request; add it to the restricted key in the Stripe Dashboard (the key check needs Balance: Read)
messages.404: Not found in Stripe; check the id and whether the key is for test or live mode
messages.409: Stripe reported a conflict, usually an Idempotency-Key reused with different parameters
messages.429: Stripe rate limit reached (see the Stripe-Rate-Limited-Reason header); back off and retry
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Stripe; retry later

presentation.tagline: Read Stripe payment and billing data and manage your product catalog from a Sprite.
presentation.setup: In the Stripe Dashboard, open Developers → API keys (dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys) and create a restricted key. Grant Balance: Read for the key check and only the other read permissions you need. Grant write permission only for catalog resources the Sprite should manage. Use a test-mode key while developing.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Stripe does not charge for API calls. Saving or testing the key reads `GET /v1/balance`. Catalog writes with a live-mode key update your live products, prices, discounts or tax rates. The connector cannot create or capture payments, refund charges, or change subscriptions.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Read balance, balance transactions, customers, payments, refunds, disputes, payouts, invoices, subscriptions, quotes, Checkout Sessions, Payment Links, billing meters and events. Only products, prices, coupons, promotion codes and tax rates accept writes. The gateway blocks Connect endpoints and account-selection headers. Your own account’s records can still reference existing Connect transactions. Within the allowed routes, your key’s Stripe permissions determine what succeeds.

notices.title: Use a restricted key
notices.body: Stripe restricted keys (`rk_...`) carry per-resource None, Read or Write permissions and can be rotated or revoked on their own. Create one with just what the Sprite needs; the key check only requires Balance: Read. A request outside the key's permissions is refused by Stripe with 403. One connection holds one key, so test mode and live mode are separate connections.

usage_notes: Stripe takes request parameters form-encoded (`-d name=Jenny`), not as a JSON body; GET parameters go in the query string. Nested fields use bracket syntax such as `expand[]=customer`.

`Stripe-Version` and `Idempotency-Key` headers are forwarded as sent. Without `Stripe-Version` the request uses your account's default API version. Send an `Idempotency-Key` on POST requests you may retry.
Stripe ids such as `cus_...`, `pi_...` and `in_...` fit the connector’s path rules.
